company.name: SimCare
company.shortDescription: SimCare provides an AI clinical simulation platform with virtual patients for counseling and healthcare skills training.
company.description: SimCare provides an AI clinical simulation platform that uses virtual patients and counseling avatars to support skills training. The platform enables students and trainees to conduct full counseling sessions with AI clients, practice building rapport, explore emotions, and plan treatment steps. It offers instant feedback on tone, empathy, communication, diagnostic accuracy, and other clinical skills. SimCare supports longitudinal interactions with the same simulated client, including follow-up sessions and messaging. Educational institutions and training programs use SimCare to embed simulation-based learning across curricula for psychology, counseling, social work, behavioral health, and related disciplines.
